logline: An 1892 Scottish lighthouse keeper discovers a message in a bottle that changes his life.

character.name: Angus MacFie
character.description: A weathered, solitary man whose life is dictated by the clockwork precision of the light and the isolation of the sea.
character.voice: Gruff, sparse, with a thick Scottish brogue.
character.wardrobe: Hand-waxed oilskin coat and hat over a heavy-knit wool sweater.

location.name: Remote Scottish Lighthouse
location.description: A towering stone structure battered by the North Sea, featuring a gleaming hyper-radial Fresnel lens powered by oil lamps and intricate clockwork mechanics.

style.color_grade: Desaturated, cold blues and greys contrasting with the warm amber glow of the oil lamp.

shot_list.description: Close-up of Angus's weathered hands winding the brass clockwork mechanism of the Fresnel lens.
Wide shot of the lighthouse standing against a raging storm, waves crashing against the rocks.
Medium shot of Angus walking the rocky shore in his oilskins, spotting a glass bottle washed up in the kelp.
